## DPStyleARWebLive.updateMaskRoi() method

Apply the renderer's mask ROI result to StyleAR. Use this to synchronize the region-of-interest mask generated by rendering so StyleAR can apply mask processing to the same ROI area.

**Signature:**

```typescript
updateMaskRoi(useMaskRoi: boolean): Promise<void>;
```
